control_design.balance_and_locomotion: local controller, independent of API timing
control_design.policy_action_candidate: bounded joint position targets with identified actuator dynamics
control_design.rate_selection: measure 11-motor bus latency before selecting rates; do not copy 50/600 Hz blindly

stand_and_look.goal_en: Keep feet planted, balance and pitch the head toward a person
stand_and_look.goal_ko: 발을 고정하고 균형을 유지하며 사람 쪽으로 머리 피치 조절

small_waddle.goal_en: Short steps with deliberate weight shift and gentle touchdown
small_waddle.goal_ko: 체중 이동과 부드러운 착지를 포함하는 짧은 보폭

greet_bow.goal_en: Small coordinated bow, return to neutral standing
greet_bow.goal_ko: 작은 전신 인사 후 중립 기립 복귀
